do.text: In a form or a composer, put the picker behind `EmojiPickerTrigger`: it opens in a popover only when wanted.

dont.text: Don't leave a whole picker open in a form for one emoji: it takes the space.

do.text: Give the picker an `aria-label` saying what the emoji is for ("Project icon"): screen readers read it with the emoji.

dont.text: Don't leave it unnamed: a screen reader then hears only "rocket", with no idea what it sets.
